changes.title: Map coasts
items: The map table on the treehouse deck shows the islands' real coastlines, and on the sea chart each island rises out of the sea as it's charted (no round stand-ins); the chart opens without the pauses the islands' arrival used to cause

changes.title: Blend 40
items: Each area's trees and bushes reach twice as far into its neighbours, so the planting blends across the borders

changes.title: Stegosaurus head
items: The stegosaurus's head is smaller, lower and beaked on a longer neck, so it no longer looks like a bear
The stegosaurus elder's lava-veined plates stand apart instead of merging into one dark mass

changes.title: Less churn
items: Fewer hitches in the treetops: the game makes much less garbage each frame (the wave pointer, the party pieces, the creatures and the lights), so the browser pauses to collect it less often

changes.title: Hydra
items: A new creature, the hydra, with its own area, the drowned wood: a many-headed serpent of the black water, one head as a baby and up to seven when grown, each crested with spines. Its legend sleeps half under the water like a heap of drowned roots, its necks ringed in old bronze and two cut-off necks grown back as two heads each; its gift is Hydra's Many Heads (your 💌s come quicker and land a little more easily). It lives on a far island, out to the south-south-west

changes.title: Growth batch 2
items: Eight more animals grow up instead of just getting bigger: a round, big-eared arctic fox kit, a squirrel and a stoat young with short tails and big heads, a newt whose crest comes in, a salamander whose tail thickens (its legend crowned with fire), a flying squirrel whose membrane spreads (glowing on its legend), a pine marten whose tail gets fluffier, and a Komodo dragon with a long heavy head and a dewlap

changes.title: Drowned larch
items: The drowned wood's larches look drowned: swollen at the waterline, their crowns dark and dying, hung with weed and moss

changes.title: Birds snake
items: Herons grow their plumes as they age, and the heron legend is now a tall elder carrying a softly glowing paper lantern in its bill
Baby ravens are downy fledglings with stubby tails
Baby snakes have bigger heads, and their markings come in as they grow

changes.title: Area edges toggle
items: The glowing dotted edges round the party's areas are gone (a pause-page switch brings them back)
